notes: Adds an authenticated local-WebSocket OBS companion dock with a unique persistent URL for every Windows installation.
Adds configurable Hack, Creator, Exit Counter, Deaths, Timers, and RetroAchievements cards without requiring an OBS Browser Source.
Adds optional Search & Play and Play Random Hack dock controls with rating, difficulty, type, release, and Hall of Fame filters.
Repairs Download and Install, the Settings update badge, and desktop-shortcut creation during the initial Windows install.
Packages complete Paramiko and cryptography support so MiSTer setup works in the released Windows EXE.
Removes the unstable experimental MiSTer Main from setup and release packages, blocks launches through that known-bad build, and keeps the verified restore path available.
Improves Overview sizing and stability while preserving the fitted Stream Desk setup and OBS pages.
Publishes Windows downloads only; macOS remains untested and is not included in this release.
